title: Define Todo model + storage adapter (localStorage v1)
Wire UI to local storage: add/list/toggle/delete
Basic accessibility + keyboard flows for MVP
Quality gates for todo-instance (build + lint) and evidence
Add unit test harness for todo-instance (Vitest + RTL)
Add automated tests for todos.storage.ts (missing/corrupt + save format)
Add automated UI test: Add rejects empty/whitespace title
description: Write a component test ensuring empty/whitespace titles do not create a todo.

title: Quality gates for Phase 2: tests + build + lint evidence
Phase 3: Define storage schema versioning + migration strategy
acceptance_criteria: Storage format is explicitly versioned (either payload schemaVersion or new key) and documented in code/readme comment-free (types/consts are fine).
Load path handles missing/corrupt data by returning an empty list (no throw).
If an older schema is detected, data is migrated to the current in-memory shape and persisted back on next save (or immediately on load if chosen).

title: Phase 3: Add filter state + UI (All / Active / Completed)
acceptance_criteria: UI provides three deterministic filter states: All, Active, Completed.
Filter selection updates visible list correctly without mutating underlying data.
Filter control is keyboard accessible and has clear accessible names/labels.

title: Phase 3: Add items-left count (and optional total count)
acceptance_criteria: UI displays active-count (items left) that updates as todos are added/toggled/deleted/cleared.
Count remains correct after refresh (load from storage).

title: Phase 3: Implement 'Clear completed' bulk action (persisted)
acceptance_criteria: Clear completed removes only completed todos.
Result is persisted to local storage.
Control is keyboard accessible and has an accessible name.

title: Phase 3: Implement 'Toggle all' bulk action (persisted)
acceptance_criteria: Toggle all marks all active → completed; if all are completed, toggles all → active.
Result is persisted to local storage.
Control is keyboard accessible and has an accessible name.

title: Phase 3: Add automated tests for storage migration + corrupt/missing behavior
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover: missing storage → empty list; corrupt JSON → empty list (no crash).
Tests cover: older schema input → migrated current shape and persisted behavior (as designed).
Tests are runnable via `npm run test -w apps/todo-instance`.

title: Phase 3: Add automated UI tests for filters + bulk actions
acceptance_criteria: UI tests verify filter behavior (All/Active/Completed) changes visible items correctly.
UI tests verify: clear completed removes only completed items.
UI tests verify: toggle all toggles expected state (including the 'all completed' toggle-back case).

title: Phase 3: Quality gates + evidence (lint/build/test all green)
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes
Quality can report `{ status, errors }` with commands_run and empty errors on pass

title: Phase 4: Refactor App.tsx into small components + todos.model helpers (no behavior change)
acceptance_criteria: Move pure business rules into `src/todos.model.ts` (filtering, counts, bulk action intent helpers) and keep them unit-testable.
Extract minimal UI components (e.g. Filters, BulkActions, TodoList) without changing runtime behavior.
All existing tests remain passing with minimal/no snapshot churn.
`npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` and `npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` pass.

title: Phase 4: Add accessible empty state when list is empty
acceptance_criteria: When there are 0 todos, UI shows a clear empty state message with accessible semantics.
Keyboard-first add flow remains intact (focus behavior not degraded).
Behavior persists across refresh (still local-only).

title: Phase 4: Inline edit todo title (Enter save / Escape cancel, trim, reject empty)
acceptance_criteria: User can enter edit mode for a todo title and modify it in-place.
Enter saves; Escape cancels and restores prior title.
Edits are trimmed; empty/whitespace-only edits are rejected (revert/no-op).
Edits persist via local storage and remain after refresh.

title: Phase 4: Add UI tests for empty state and inline edit keyboard flows
acceptance_criteria: UI tests cover empty state rendering when there are zero todos.
UI tests cover inline edit: Enter saves, Escape cancels, trimming behavior, and reject-empty behavior.
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes.

title: Phase 4 (optional): Undo delete (local-only, in-memory buffer acceptable)
acceptance_criteria: After deleting a todo, user can undo within a short time window (or until next action) without backend involvement.
Undo restores the deleted todo with its original id/title/done/createdAt fields.
If implemented, add at least one UI test covering undo flow.

title: Phase 4: Quality gates + evidence (lint/build/test all green)
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes
Quality can report `{ status, errors, commands_run }` with empty errors on pass

title: Phase 5: Update todo spec to match current storage payload + add Phase 5 hardening section
description: Spec currently states storage is a JSON array; implementation uses a versioned payload. Update Storage rules accordingly and add a Phase 5 section describing forward-schema guardrail + phase convention consistency.
acceptance_criteria: `specs/todo-spec.md` Storage rules reflect versioned payload `{ schemaVersion, todos }` (not array-only).
Spec explicitly defines behavior for `schemaVersion > current` (forward version guardrail).
Add a Phase 5 section with scope + non-goals + verification approach (still local-only; no API/auth).

title: Phase 5: Add explicit guardrail for future storage schemaVersion (forward compat)
description: Make handling of `schemaVersion > TODOS_SCHEMA_VERSION` explicit and deterministic (no crash; no accidental overwrite).
acceptance_criteria: If persisted payload has `schemaVersion > TODOS_SCHEMA_VERSION`, load returns `[]` (or a clearly defined safe fallback) without throwing.
Forward-version payload does NOT get overwritten by an empty save during load (i.e., shouldPersist is false for forward versions).
Behavior is documented via code-level constants/types (no narration-only comments).

title: Phase 5: Add automated tests for forward-schema guardrail (schemaVersion > current)
description: Lock the forward-compat behavior with unit tests alongside existing storage tests.
acceptance_criteria: Test covers: payload with higher schemaVersion does not crash and results in safe behavior per spec.
Test covers: forward-version does not trigger persistence overwrite on load.
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes.

title: Phase 5: Tooling check to enforce numeric string `phase` convention in task queue
description: Prevent future drift like mixing "Phase 3" and "3" by adding/strengthening validation logic.
acceptance_criteria: Validation fails if `phase` is non-numeric (e.g. "Phase 3").
Error message points to task id(s) with invalid phase values.
Document how to run the validation (e.g. `npm run check` or a dedicated script) in an appropriate doc location.

title: Phase 5: Quality gates + evidence (lint/build/test all green)
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes
Quality reports `{ status, errors, commands_run }` with empty errors on pass

title: Phase 6: Spec alignment for local-only export/import + ordering
acceptance_criteria: `specs/todo-spec.md` contains a Phase 6 section that is explicitly local-only (no API/auth).
Phase 6 scope includes export/import and deterministic ordering.

title: Phase 6: Add export/import UI for todos (local-only)
description: Add Export (download JSON) and Import (paste/select JSON) UI actions; must be resilient to invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Export downloads a JSON payload `{ schemaVersion, todos }` matching current storage shape.
Import accepts current payload and legacy array; invalid JSON does not crash the app.
Import updates in-memory state and persists via storage adapter.

title: Phase 6: Ensure deterministic ordering (newest-first by createdAt)
description: Make visible ordering deterministic and resilient when createdAt is missing (safe fallback).
acceptance_criteria: New todos always have createdAt set.
List order is deterministic (newest-first by createdAt with a safe fallback).
Ordering remains stable after import and refresh.

title: Phase 6: Add automated tests for export/import + ordering
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover export payload shape.
Tests cover import: v1 payload, legacy array payload, and invalid JSON (no crash).
Tests cover ordering is deterministic after import/add.

title: Phase 6: Quality gates + evidence (lint/build/test/check all green)
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run check` passes
`npm run validate-task-queue` passes (if present)

title: Phase 7: Spec alignment for UX/UI (Tailwind + Headless UI, local-only)
description: Phase 7 requires Tailwind CSS + @headlessui/react per architecture-review-003; see specs/todo-spec.md.
acceptance_criteria: `specs/todo-spec.md` Phase 7 names **Tailwind CSS** + **`@headlessui/react`**, tooling scope, tokens via `theme.extend`, dark mode via `prefers-color-scheme` minimum, feedback + a11y, non-goals (no heavy UI kits).
References `organizational_memory/architecture-review-002-2026-05-08.md` and `architecture-review-003-2026-05-08-phase7-ui-stack.md`.
Stays local-only (no API/auth/sync).

title: Phase 7: Tooling — Tailwind CSS + PostCSS + @headlessui/react + Vite wiring
acceptance_criteria: `apps/todo-instance` lists `tailwindcss`, `postcss`, `autoprefixer` (dev) and `@headlessui/react` (dependency) with working install from repo root.
`tailwind.config` (or equivalent) scans `./index.html` and `./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}`; `postcss.config` includes tailwind + autoprefixer if using PostCSS pipeline.
`src/index.css` (or agreed entry) contains Tailwind directives; `main.tsx` imports global styles.
No unused Headless imports (lint clean).
`npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` and `npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` pass.

title: Phase 7: Tailwind tokens, layout shell, dark mode, Headless primitives on UI
acceptance_criteria: `theme.extend` defines shared palette, spacing, radius, typography; components use utilities (not only raw browser defaults).
Page structure: header / main / optional footer utilities; max-width comfortable on wide screens.
Light + dark via `prefers-color-scheme` (Tailwind `darkMode: 'media'` or equivalent); optional manual toggle documented if added.
Headless UI used where it adds accessibility (e.g. `Button`, `Listbox` for filters per spec)—styled with Tailwind.
`npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` and `npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` pass.

title: Phase 7: Import/export accessible feedback + main landmark + h1
acceptance_criteria: Import: user-visible success/error for invalid JSON, unusable payload, etc.; `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` (or equivalent).
Export: brief user-visible confirmation.
`main` landmark + sensible `h1`; keyboard flows unchanged for add, filters, bulk, inline edit, undo.
`npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` passes.

title: Phase 7: Automated tests (import feedback, landmark/heading, theme signal)
acceptance_criteria: Tests: import failure + success paths expose status/live region text.
Tests: stable dark/theme signal (e.g. `html` class, `data-theme`) without brittle snapshots.
Tests: `main` / heading presence per Phase 7.
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes.

title: Phase 7: Quality gates + evidence (lint/build/test/check + validate-task-queue)
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run build -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run test -w apps/todo-instance` passes
`npm run check` passes
`npm run validate-task-queue` passes

title: Define task queue JSON schema
description: Add a first-class schema for factory/task-queue.json covering required fields, optional PM fields, status values, depends_on shape, assigned_agent, priority, app, and blocked_reason.
acceptance_criteria: A schema exists under factory/schemas/ for task queue entries and the full queue envelope/array shape currently supported by loaders.
Schema accepts existing valid task-queue.json content.
Schema documents allowed statuses and expected field types without requiring vertical-only fields.

title: Harden task queue validation
description: Extend npm run validate-task-queue beyond phase checks to enforce uniqueness, dependency integrity, acyclic graph, status values, and registry-aligned assigned_agent values.
acceptance_criteria: Validation fails on duplicate ids, unknown depends_on ids, self-dependencies, cycles, invalid statuses, and invalid assigned_agent values.
Validation errors name the failing task id and field.
Existing factory/task-queue.json validates successfully after any necessary non-behavioral cleanup.

title: Add task queue validator fixtures
description: Create small valid and invalid fixture files for task queue validation so future changes are evidence-backed.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover at least: valid queue, duplicate id, unknown dependency, dependency cycle, invalid assigned_agent, and invalid status.
A documented command runs validation against fixtures and exits nonzero for invalid cases.
Fixture expectations are deterministic and do not depend on current backlog size.

title: Gate task queue validation in CI
description: Wire task queue validation into the factory CI workflow so PRs cannot merge with broken task graph metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Factory CI runs npm run validate-task-queue on pull_request.
CI output clearly separates task queue validation from typecheck/orchestrator output.
The gate uploads or prints enough evidence for Quality to cite the command result.

title: Validate agent registry references
description: Add validation for factory/agent-registry.json references so agent files, context packs, schemas, and next_agents stay in sync.
acceptance_criteria: A script validates agent-registry.json against its schema.
The script fails if an agent file, context_pack, output_schema, or next_agents entry points to a missing or unknown item.
An npm script exposes the validator from package.json.

title: Gate agent registry validation in CI
description: Add the agent registry validator to the factory CI path.
acceptance_criteria: Factory CI runs the registry validator on pull_request.
A broken file path or unknown next_agents value causes a clear CI failure.
Quality can cite the exact command in pass/fail evidence.

title: Align agent output validator with schemas
description: Bring validate-agent-output behavior closer to factory/schemas/* so PM, Dev, and Quality payload validation is deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: PM validation checks id pattern, acceptance_criteria item types, depends_on item types, status enum, and assigned_agent when present.
Quality validation accepts documented schema fields while preserving fail requires errors[] behavior.
Validator errors include agent kind and JSON path-like field names.

title: Add agent output validation fixtures
description: Add valid and invalid PM/Dev/Quality fixture payloads for validate-agent-output.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures include at least one valid and one invalid payload for PM, Dev, and Quality.
A single documented command verifies all valid fixtures pass and invalid fixtures fail.
Invalid fixture failures are stable enough for Quality evidence.

title: Define QMS inbox record schema
description: Add a machine-readable schema for optional QMS inbox companion JSON records described by agents/agent-record-for-qms.md.
acceptance_criteria: Schema includes schema_version, date_utc, agent_role, task_id, depends_on, spec_pr_refs, evidence_paths, and handoff_next_role.
agent_role values align with factory/agent-registry.json role ids.
Schema avoids storing secrets or full logs by design.

title: Add QMS inbox evidence validator
description: Create a lightweight validator for QMS inbox companion JSON files and required Markdown headings.
acceptance_criteria: Validator checks companion JSON files against the QMS inbox schema when present.
Validator checks Markdown inbox records for required headings from agents/agent-record-for-qms.md.
Validator reports filename and missing/invalid section without rewriting records.

title: Add QMS evidence gate fixtures
description: Quality-owned fixtures and command evidence for the QMS inbox validator.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover valid Markdown, missing heading, valid companion JSON, and invalid companion JSON.
A documented command verifies the QMS validator behavior.
Quality output can cite commands_run and fixture outcomes.

title: Clarify role boundary matrix
description: Update agent routing docs with a concise ownership matrix for PM, Dev, Tooling, Docs, Quality, DevOps, and Fix around factory-system work.
acceptance_criteria: Docs identify who owns schemas, validators, CI gates, task decomposition, QMS inbox records, and controlled docs.
Docs explicitly state that Quality owns harness/gates/evidence and Docs owns published QMS consolidation.
Docs avoid changing existing vertical architecture decisions.

title: Document task queue conventions
description: Add human-facing conventions for task ids, priority semantics, status transitions, depends_on rules, app values, and closure expectations.
acceptance_criteria: Docs explain whether higher or lower priority runs first based on current planner behavior.
Docs include examples for factory/ and organizational_memory/ system tasks.
Docs reference post-merge closure: status done plus QMS evidence.

title: Make next-task prompts role-aware
description: Update factory planning output so suggested prompts respect assigned_agent instead of always defaulting to Dev plus Quality.
acceptance_criteria: factory:next JSON includes a next agent invocation based on assigned_agent when present.
Dev and Git handoffs mention branch-first expectations when applicable.
Existing Dev and Quality prompt helpers remain covered for product implementation tasks.

title: Document factory:next JSON contract
description: Document the fields emitted by factory:next and how agents should consume suggested next moves.
acceptance_criteria: Docs show example output for a Dev task, Quality task, Docs task, and Tooling task.
Docs explain WIP cap behavior and blocked/done/in_progress handling.
Docs reference task queue conventions instead of duplicating conflicting rules.

title: Publish factory CI evidence artifacts
description: Standardize CI outputs for validators and planning so Quality and PR reviewers have durable evidence.
acceptance_criteria: CI stores or prints artifacts for parallel-plan output, task queue validation, registry validation, agent output fixtures, and QMS evidence checks.
Artifact names are stable and documented.
Quality can reference the artifacts in a pass/fail JSON report.

title: Publish factory delivery loop procedure
description: Docs Agent consolidates the updated factory-system workflow into a controlled QMS-style procedure.
acceptance_criteria: Published QMS doc describes system-task flow from PM backlog through Tooling/Dev/Docs, Quality gates, Git, and post-merge closure.
Document control metadata and revision history follow existing QMS published format.
The procedure references validators and CI gates added by prior tasks.

title: Run end-to-end factory spine gate
description: Quality performs final verification across the factory scripts, docs, schemas, CI configuration, and QMS evidence workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Quality runs npm run check, npm run factory, npm run factory:next, npm run parallel-plan, npm run validate-task-queue, registry validation, agent output fixture checks, and QMS evidence validation.
Quality reports structured pass/fail JSON with commands_run, acceptance_criteria_verified, and errors.
Any failure is routed to Fix or Tooling with exact reproduction steps.
